🏠 Delivery MethodCurbside Delivery (Included):

Scandia products may be delivered to the curb or driveway.

The freight company will contact you 1–3 days in advance to schedule a delivery window.

Note: Customers are responsible for moving the product indoors.
🧤 Optional Delivery UpgradesWhite Glove ServiceDelivery to any room of your home (stairs included)Unpacking, assembly, and installation are not includedAdditional fees apply; allow 2–5 business days for schedulingPremium Installation & AssemblyIncludes White Glove Service plus full product assembly and setupElectrical work may be required, depending on the product (e.g., for sauna wiring)Additional labor costs apply:$50–$75/hr per installer$75–$150+/hr for licensed electricians (varies by location)Allow 3–10 business days for installer scheduling❓ Need Help?We’re here to assist you with delivery coordination, upgrade options, or shipping timelines.

📧 Support@InHouseWellness.com

📱 Text or call us for real-time assistance.
